Alternatively set reachable_proxy=false, isolation_verified=false → still X (falls to X). Give X with facts.

rh_facts: reachable_proxy false, isolation_verified null, verified_episodes null, episodes null, locus null.

Simple scripted curl — if attacker can reach the endpoint, fully automatable; but loopback default requires local action. Say Yes with caveat? Keep "Yes": attack via curl is scriptable once reach. Hmm UI:P implies human in loop; automatable asks whether exploitation can be automated — via crafted web page not automated. I'll say Yes (API call, no human approval).
